findings: An infiltrative pancreatic cancer measuring 58 mm is observed in the head of the pancreas. Serosal invasion and retropancreatic tissue invasion are noted. There is contact of more than 180° with both the portal vein and the superior mesenteric vein, along with vascular stenosis, suggesting invasion. No invasion beyond the inferior border of the duodenum is observed. Contact of less than 180° with the celiac artery is noted, raising suspicion of invasion, although no deformation or stenosis of the celiac artery is observed. The tumor does not involve the common hepatic artery or proper hepatic artery. No other local invasion factors are identified. No lymph node metastases are present. No other metastases are observed.

responses.content:
Task 1: Diagnose the local invasion factors of pancreatic cancer.

CH0 (no contact with common hepatic artery)
DU0 (no invasion beyond the inferior border of the duodenum)
S1 (serosal invasion)
RP1 (retropancreatic tissue invasion)
PV1 (invasion of portal vein)
A1 (contact with celiac artery, raising suspicion of invasion)
PL0 (no contact with proper hepatic artery)
OO0 (no other local invasion factors)

Task 2: Determine the classification for local invasion (T classification) of pancreatic cancer.

Based on the size of the tumor (58 mm) and the presence of serosal invasion (S1), retropancreatic tissue invasion (RP1), and vascular invasion (PV1), the T classification is T3.

Task 3: Determine the N classification of pancreatic cancer.

Regional lymph nodes for pancreatic cancer are:
- Stations 12a, 12b, 12c, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18, and 19 for tumors in the head of the pancreas.

No metastatic lymph nodes are present, so N0.

Task 4: Determine the M classification of pancreatic cancer.

No distant metastases are present, so M0.

Task 5: Determine the resectability classification of pancreatic cancer.

No criteria for Borderline Resectable (BR) or Unresectable (UR) are met, so Resectable (R).

Task 6: Determine the overall stage according to the JPS staging system.

T3, N0, M0, Resectable (R) corresponds to Stage IIA.
